visible_labels: Turns this department's NERIS validation, submission and NERIS setup screens on or off. Other Records settings, records and history are unchanged; the NERIS profile and queued submissions are kept for re-enabling.

Turning NERIS off stops NERIS validation, submission and status checks, and hides the NERIS setup screens and figures. Incident reports and every other Records setting keep working. Your NERIS profile, code mappings and submission history are kept, and queued submissions wait until NERIS is turned back on.
NERIS submission is switched off system-wide; reports can be authored and finalized but not delivered.

How record numbers are written for the built-in record types and incident reports, for example RUN-0153: fixed text plus the PREFIX, YYYY or YY, GROUP and SEQ tokens. PREFIX writes each record type's prefix: its default or the department's own, from "Record type prefixes". Changing the pattern never renumbers records already numbered. Until a pattern is saved, the screen shows the one the department has always used.

Use {PREFIX} for the record type (RUN, TRN, INC and so on), {YYYY} or {YY} for the year, {GROUP} for the station or group (G followed by its ID, which must be followed by -, _ or .), and {SEQ} for the sequence, which is required. Letters, digits, -, _ and . are kept as written. The sequence restarts whenever the text around {SEQ} changes: including the year restarts it every year, and leaving out {PREFIX} gives every record type one shared sequence.
